install:
test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" || curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/mise" trust /workspace/.mise.toml
"$HOME/.local/bin/mise" install
"$HOME/.local/bin/mise" use -g jj@0.43.0
"$HOME/.local/bin/mise" use -g "aqua:nushell/nushell@0.114.1"
test -x "$HOME/.vite-plus/bin/vp" || curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash
"$HOME/.vite-plus/bin/vp" install
